Zouken Matou and Assassin.

The black shadow prowling the city.

The battle between Masters for the Holy Grail.

I resolved to fight in order to stop them all, and sacrificed Saber for that decision.

…Then I cannot sacrifice anyone else.

From this point onward, I have to fight alone.

戦力的に劣る自分に必要なものは、武器と確かな情報だろう。

pages.en:
—The day comes to an end.

Even if I mean to pursue the black shadow and Zouken, I cannot act until nightfall.

Outmatched as I am, what I need most is a weapon and reliable information.

…When night comes, I will have to slip into Ryuudou Temple or the Matou residence and find some kind of clue.

…I’ll wait until night, sneak into the Ryuudou Temple, and try to obtain some information.

Something like a footprint mars the hallway.

Someone entered the house without removing their shoes, and now the place is utterly still.

Only Sakura's shoes remain. The housekeeper I arranged for must already have gone home.

もっとも

pages.en:
‘Whew. What's gotten into you today, Emiya? You're unusually sharp. Listen carefully: the place is our school. Come alone, and you can take Sakura away exactly as she is.

‘…But don't get any clever ideas. Rider has erected a bounded field around the school. If you bring Saber, we'll know immediately.

‘Though I suppose you would never stoop to anything so cowardly in front of Sakura.’
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wow, you’re pretty bright today. Look, we’ll fight at school.
I’ll give Sakura back to you if you come alone.
If you come for her alone, you can take Sakura with you.
…Oh, but don’t try to pull any shit with me. Rider set up a boundary field over the school. I’ll know right away if you bring Saber along.
If that happensI can’t guarantee what’ll happen to her.”
Though of courseI don’t think you’d do something so cowardly in front of Sakura.”

I hear him snickering on the other end of the phone.

桜には手を出すな」
『オーケー、できるだけ早く来いよ。
けどまあ、少し帰りが遅すぎたんじゃないかな。
大事な僕の妹を待たせるなんて、なんて非道い奴だろう。なぁ衛宮？』

“I'm coming now, so wait there. —Don't lay a hand on Sakura.”

‘Okay. You'd better hurry.

‘Though perhaps you already came home a little too late.

‘Making my precious sister wait—what a terrible man you are. Wouldn't you agree, Emiya?’
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’ll go right away. Don’t do anything else to Sakura.”
“Hah…! Fine, I’ll take that exchange.
“Okay, come as fast as you can.
But still, didn’t you take your time coming home?
You say not to do anything else to Sakura, but even I can’t think of any other things to do to her that I haven’t already tried.”
You’re a pretty cruel guy, making my precious little sister wait. Aren’t you, Emiya?”

“—What did you do to Sakura, Shinji?”

‘Nothing at all. If anything, I'm having trouble restraining Rider. Just like that night. You see, Rider has been looking at her for some time as though there were a feast laid out before her—’

受話器を叩きつける。
「なんで、直接俺にこない」
笑い声がまだ耳に残っている。
怒りで千切れそうな神経のまま、地面を蹴った。

pages.en:
I slam down the receiver.

“Why didn't you come after me yourself?”

His laughter still rings in my ears.

Every nerve ready to snap with rage, I kick off against the ground.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I smack down the receiver.
“You did it, Shinji.”
“Why didn’t he come at me directly?”
I can still hear his laugh.
I set off for school, my nerves blazing with anger.

pages.ja:
外に出る。
見上げた空は暗く、じき日が沈もうとしていた。
今夜はきっと雨になる。
その前に、桜と一緒にここに戻ってこないといけない。

pages.en:
I rush outside.

The sky overhead is dark, and the sun will soon disappear.

It will surely rain tonight.

Before it does, I have to bring Sakura home.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I go outside.
The sky is dark, and the sun’s about to set.
I bet it’ll rain tonight.
I have to come home with Sakura before that.

pages.ja:
校舎には人気がない。
昏睡事件の多発が下校時刻を早めた為だ。
五時を過ぎた今、生徒はおろか教師さえ残ってはいないだろう。

The school is deserted.

The rash of coma incidents has moved dismissal to an earlier hour.

Now that it is past five, not even the teachers should remain, much less the students.

Thanks to the series of comas, the school closed early.

魔術回路はとっくに成っている。
俺に許されたただ一つの“強化”を、すぐにでも揮えるように集中する。

—A bar of searing iron runs down my back.

My Magic Circuit has long since formed.

I concentrate, ready at any moment to wield the only “weapon” permitted to me: Reinforcement.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There’s hot steel in my back.
The Magic Circuit is already made.
I concentrate so that I can use my only weapon whenever necessary.

pages.ja:
ライダーの結界とやらか。
校舎は真紅に染まり、呼吸する度に肺が傷ついていく。
咳き込む喉から血が零れる。
構わず、階段を駆け上る。

pages.en:
—So this is Rider's bounded field.

The school building is dyed crimson, and every breath tears at my lungs.

Blood spills from my throat as I cough.

Ignoring it, I race up the stairs.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It must be Rider’s boundary field.
The school’s tinted red, and my lungs are damaged every time I breathe.
I cough up blood.
But I ignore it and run up the stairs.

pages.ja:
確証はなかったが、予測はできていた。
慎二の性格上、馴染みのない場所には陣取らない。
あいつがいるとすれば三階の教室だ。

pages.en:
I have no proof, but I can predict where he will be.

Shinji's temperament would never let him make his stand in unfamiliar surroundings.

If he is anywhere, it will be the classroom on the third floor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m not certain, but I can still guess.
Considering Shinji, he wouldn’t position himself on unfamiliar territory.
He has to be in the classroom on the third floor.

pages.ja:
三階に上がる。
赤いフィルターは濃度を増し、一歩ごとに魔力を削ぎ落としていく。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I reach the third floor.

The red veil grows denser, stripping away magical energy with every step I take.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I get up to the third floor.
The red filter condenses, scraping off my magical energy with each step I take.

俺を待っていたのか。
慎二は２年Ｃ組の前で俺を見据えていた。

Has he been waiting for me?

Shinji stands before the door to Class 2-C, staring me down.

“—Shinji…!”

“Hah—you finally came, Emiya…!”

My head burns white.

I have to confirm that she is safe, this instant.

If Shinji stands in my way, I will show him no mercy. I will—

My brain boils up.

I have to check if she’s all right.
If Shinji would get in my way, I would mercilessly…

立ち塞がる黒いサーヴァント。
構わない。
相手が何であろうと、もう止まる事など出来ない。

pages.en:
“You're up, Rider! He's the Master of the Saber who cut you down…! Repay what she did to you that night…!”

The black Servant bars my path.

—It does not matter.

Whoever my opponent may be, there is no stopping me now.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It’s your turn, Rider! It’s the Master of the one who defeated you…! Repay him for that insult…!”
The black Servant stands in my way.
I don’t care.
I can’t stop, no matter who may be in front of me.

pages.ja:
振るわれる短剣。
それを、自分でも驚くほどの先読みで躱した。
斬り上げられた短剣を躱し、ライダーの左横を通り過ぎる。
長い髪と長身のせいか、ライダーはすれ違う俺を掴まえられない。

pages.en:
—Her dagger swings.

I evade it with an anticipation so precise that even I am astonished.

Slipping past the rising blade, I dart by Rider's left side.

Perhaps her height and long hair work against her, for she fails to catch me as we pass.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The dagger is swung.
I read its course with amazing speed and avoid it.
Having dodged the dagger, I pass by Rider next.
It must be because of her tall figure and her long hair, but Rider cannot seize me as I rush past.

距離にしてあと五メートル、二秒とかけず慎二に詰め寄って、ライダーを操る令呪を、
「っ…………！！！！？」
舌が伸びる。
首を、背後から締め付けられた。

pages.en:
—I have him.

Five meters remain. In less than two seconds I close on Shinji, reaching for the Command Spells with which he controls Rider—

“Gh…………!!!!?”

My tongue is forced from my mouth.

Something coils around my neck from behind.

“………!!!!?”
My tongue bulges from my mouth.

pages.en:
“—Haa. Honestly, what are you doing, Rider? Letting Emiya run circles around you—is that any way for a Servant to behave?”

“………My apologies. I underestimated the depth of his concentration.”

Rider's voice comes from directly behind me.

“Gh… kh, ah…!”

My feet are no longer touching the floor.

Rider has tightened her chain around my throat and lifted me into the air—

“Ha—ggh…………!”

I cannot brace myself to resist.

Rider is behind me. I cannot see my enemy. My throat is constricted, already—

“Your failure to remain calm has decided the battle, Master of Saber.

“Sakura cannot be entrusted to you. …It is against my wishes, but your life will end here.”

“Gh——…………”

…Consciousness recedes.

I was so close.

So terribly close, yet my body hangs helpless in the air—

And I hear the pitiless crack of my bones breaking.

“……I am sorry. I took his concentration lightly.”
I hear Rider’s voice from right behind me.
“Guh… kuh, ah…!”
My feet don’t reach the ground.
Rider has wrapped a chain about my neck and lifted my body off the floor.

Rider is out of sight behind me, and my neck is already

A bit more.

my neck
bones
